60972.hook: A working illustrator explains pens, papers and the new photographic processes remaking printed pictures.

60973.hook: A pocketful of vaudeville patter and groan-worthy puns straight off the variety stage.

60974.hook: A homely-faced but brilliant girl detective turns her plain looks into her sharpest disguise tool.
